rules.title: Guest bedroom in North
rules.explanation: The North-West is traditionally preferred for temporary occupants and guests.
rules.practical_impact: Provides traceable Knowledge coverage for guest bedroom placement.
rules.architectural_note: Reassign rooms rather than alter structure when possible.
rules.existing_home_note: Keep the guest room welcoming, airy and minimally cluttered.
rules.source_note: Belief-based guidance; interpretations and schools may vary.
